teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Pronouns + to be (Where are you from?).
Welcome to today's lesson: Pronouns + to be (Where are you from?)! Today we will practice how to use subject pronouns I, you, he, she, it, we, they.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Pronouns + to be (Where are you from?):
use subject pronouns I, you, he, she, it, we, they; form positive and negative sentences with the verb to be
